dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Visible gradual geometric narrowing from the maximum width at the pectoral region toward the posterior peduncle, which eventually becomes obscured by surface water turbulence.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Symmetrical lateral margins with localized convex bulges at the insertion points of the pectoral fins; otherwise exhibiting smooth, continuous curves.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white baseline across the entire visible dorsal surface with minimal grayscale variance outside of shadows.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of faint, low-contrast linear striations (shallow scratches) across the mid-dorsal and posterior-left dorsal regions.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Deep, dark-pixel circular indentation at the blowhole site; prominent longitudinal dorsal ridge creating a distinct topological peak and shadow-casting line along the posterior half of the visible body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor superficial linear marks/scratches on the mid-dorsal plane, likely environmental or conspecific interactions.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly pronounced and straight dorsal ridge originating posterior to the mid-back, extending toward the submerged fluke area.
